steps.caption: Team tab
steps.narration: Each person on your team uses a seat on your CRM plan. Here is where to check your seats.

steps.selector: text=Deactivated members don't use a seat
steps.caption: Seats
steps.narration: The Team tab opens with Seats. It names your plan and the seats it includes.

steps.caption: Used of total
steps.narration: The badge shows seats used, out of the total. It's green while a seat is free.

steps.caption: Red when full
steps.narration: A red badge means every seat is taken.

steps.caption: Invite someone
steps.narration: You need a free seat to invite someone new.

steps.caption: Team members
steps.narration: Everyone listed under Team members uses a seat.

steps.caption: The owner too
steps.narration: That includes you, the owner. Here six people are listed, and six seats are in use.

steps.caption: Remove from team
steps.narration: The trash can removes someone from the team. They lose access right away.

steps.selector: text=Deactivated members don't use a seat
steps.caption: Deactivated members
steps.narration: Deactivated members don't use a seat, so the seat is free again.

steps.caption: Menu: Team & Company
steps.narration: You'll find Seats under Team and Company in the menu.

youtube.title: How to check the seats on your CRM plan | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Seats in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see how many seats your plan includes, how many are in use, who is using them, and how a seat becomes free again.
